item.title: Hear How You Can Help Boost Nation’s Blood Supply with American Red Cross
item.description: The American Red Cross recently declared a severe drop in the nation's blood supply and the organization is asking communities to step up and make a difference.

item.title: March 3: La Puerta Point of Historical Interest Celebration
item.description: The City of Santa Clarita is proud to celebrate that La Puerta, a historically significant natural passage in Elsmere Canyon, has been officially named as a Point of Historical Interest by the State of California.
